description.value: Sonbadas Steakhouse is a long-standing Terrace institution, serving the community for over 50 years with AAA-plus sterling silver meats alongside homemade Greek dishes and fresh seafood — all made without preservatives or dyes. The menu spans brunch through dinner, with appetizers, pastas, salads, and a kids' menu, plus handcrafted cocktails, wine, and beer. Touring cyclists riding through the Skeena region will find a proper sit-down meal with online ordering and pickup available.
